'use strict';
/* التلوين والفحص (JS/JSON/CSS/HTML) */
/* ---------- Tokenizers: out = [start,end,class, ...] ---------- */
const JS_KW = new Set('var let const function return if else for while do switch case break continue new this typeof instanceof in of delete void try catch finally throw class extends super import export default async await yield static null true false undefined NaN Infinity'.split(' '));
const RX_BEFORE = new Set(['return', 'typeof', 'case', 'in', 'of', 'delete', 'void', 'throw', 'new', 'else', 'do', 'yield', 'await']);
const JS_BUILTIN = new Set('SpreadsheetApp DriveApp UrlFetchApp Logger console JSON Math Date Array Object String Number Boolean RegExp Promise Map Set Utilities PropertiesService CacheService ScriptApp ContentService HtmlService GmailApp CalendarApp DocumentApp SlidesApp LockService Session XmlService Blob window document Error'.split(' '));
const RE_ID = /[A-Za-z_$\u0080-\uffff][\w$\u0080-\uffff]*/y;
const RE_NUM = /0[xX][\da-fA-F]+|0[bB][01]+|(?:\d+\.?\d*|\.\d+)(?:[eE][+-]?\d+)?/y;

function tokTpl(s, i, end, out) {
  let st = i; i++;
  while (i < end) {
    const c = s[i];
    if (c === '\\') { i += 2; continue; }
    if (c === '`') { out.push(st, i + 1, 's'); return i + 1; }
    if (c === '$' && s[i + 1] === '{') {
      out.push(st, i, 's'); out.push(i, i + 2, 'p');
      const j = tokJS(s, i + 2, end, out, true);
      if (j < end && s[j] === '}') { out.push(j, j + 1, 'p'); i = j + 1; } else i = j;
      st = i; continue;
    }
    i++;
  }
  out.push(st, Math.min(i, end), 'se'); return end;
}
function tokJS(s, i, end, out, inTpl) {
  let depth = 0, prev = 'op', prevWord = '';
  while (i < end) {
    const c = s[i], n = s[i + 1];
    if (c === ' ' || c === '\t' || c === '\n' || c === '\r') { i++; continue; }
    if (c === '/' && n === '/') { let e = s.indexOf('\n', i); if (e < 0 || e > end) e = end; out.push(i, e, 'c'); i = e; continue; }
    if (c === '/' && n === '*') {
      const e = s.indexOf('*/', i + 2);
      if (e < 0 || e + 2 > end) { out.push(i, end, 'se'); i = end; } else { out.push(i, e + 2, 'c'); i = e + 2; }
      continue;
    }
    if (c === '"' || c === "'") {
      let j = i + 1;
      while (j < end && s[j] !== c && s[j] !== '\n') { if (s[j] === '\\') j++; j++; }
      j = Math.min(j, end);
      if (j < end && s[j] === c) { out.push(i, j + 1, 's'); i = j + 1; } else { out.push(i, j, 'se'); i = j; }
      prev = 'val'; prevWord = ''; continue;
    }
    if (c === '`') { i = tokTpl(s, i, end, out); prev = 'val'; prevWord = ''; continue; }
    if ((c >= '0' && c <= '9') || (c === '.' && n >= '0' && n <= '9')) {
      RE_NUM.lastIndex = i; const m = RE_NUM.exec(s);
      if (m && i + m[0].length <= end) { out.push(i, i + m[0].length, 'n'); i += m[0].length; } else i++;
      prev = 'val'; prevWord = ''; continue;
    }
    RE_ID.lastIndex = i;
    const m = RE_ID.exec(s);
    if (m && m.index === i) {
      const w = m[0], e = i + w.length; let q = e;
      while (s[q] === ' ' || s[q] === '\t') q++;
      let cls = null;
      if (prev === 'dot') cls = s[q] === '(' ? 'f' : 'pr';
      else if (JS_KW.has(w)) cls = 'k';
      else if (JS_BUILTIN.has(w)) cls = 'b';
      else if (s[q] === '(') cls = 'f';
      else if (prevWord === 'class' || prevWord === 'new') cls = 'cl';
      if (cls) out.push(i, e, cls);
      prev = RX_BEFORE.has(w) ? 'op' : 'val'; prevWord = w; i = e; continue;
    }
    if (c === '/') {
      if (prev === 'op') {
        let j = i + 1, inCls = false;
        while (j < end && s[j] !== '\n') {
          const d = s[j];
          if (d === '\\') j++; else if (d === '[') inCls = true; else if (d === ']') inCls = false; else if (d === '/' && !inCls) break;
          j++;
        }
        if (j < end && s[j] === '/') {
          j++; while (j < end && /[a-z]/i.test(s[j])) j++;
          out.push(i, j, 'rx'); i = j; prev = 'val'; prevWord = ''; continue;
        }
      }
      i++; prev = 'op'; prevWord = ''; continue;
    }
    if (c === '{') depth++;
    else if (c === '}') { if (depth === 0 && inTpl) return i; depth--; }
    if (c === '.') prev = (n !== '.' && s[i - 1] !== '.') ? 'dot' : 'op';
    else if (c === ')' || c === ']') prev = 'val';
    else prev = 'op';
    prevWord = ''; i++;
  }
  return i;
}
const RE_JNUM = /-?\d+\.?\d*(?:[eE][+-]?\d+)?/y, RE_JLIT = /true|false|null/y;
function tokJSON(s, i, end, out) {
  while (i < end) {
    const c = s[i];
    if (c === '"') {
      let j = i + 1;
      while (j < end && s[j] !== '"' && s[j] !== '\n') { if (s[j] === '\\') j++; j++; }
      j = Math.min(j, end);
      const closed = j < end && s[j] === '"', e = closed ? j + 1 : j;
      let q = e; while (q < end && (s[q] === ' ' || s[q] === '\n' || s[q] === '\t' || s[q] === '\r')) q++;
      out.push(i, e, !closed ? 'se' : (s[q] === ':' ? 'pr' : 's')); i = Math.max(e, i + 1); continue;
    }
    if ((c >= '0' && c <= '9') || c === '-') {
      RE_JNUM.lastIndex = i; const m = RE_JNUM.exec(s);
      if (m && m[0].length) { out.push(i, i + m[0].length, 'n'); i += m[0].length; continue; }
    }
    if (c === 't' || c === 'f' || c === 'n') {
      RE_JLIT.lastIndex = i; const m = RE_JLIT.exec(s);
      if (m) { out.push(i, i + m[0].length, 'k'); i += m[0].length; continue; }
    }
    i++;
  }
}
const RE_CSSID = /[\w-]+/y, RE_HEX = /#[0-9a-fA-F]{3,8}\b/y, RE_IMP = /!\s*important/y, RE_CNUM = /-?(?:\d+\.?\d*|\.\d+)(?:%|[a-zA-Z]+)?/y;
const RE_CIDENT = /[a-zA-Z_-][\w-]*/y, RE_AT = /@[\w-]+/y, RE_CCLS = /[.#][\w-]+/y, RE_PSEUDO = /::?[\w-]+/y, RE_TAGN = /[a-zA-Z][\w-]*/y;
function tokCSS(s, i, end, out) {
  const stack = []; let pre = i, inVal = false;
  const at = (re, cls) => { re.lastIndex = i; const m = re.exec(s); if (m && m.index === i && m[0].length) { out.push(i, i + m[0].length, cls); i += m[0].length; return true; } return false; };
  while (i < end) {
    const c = s[i];
    if (c === '/' && s[i + 1] === '*') {
      const e = s.indexOf('*/', i + 2);
      if (e < 0 || e + 2 > end) { out.push(i, end, 'se'); i = end; } else { out.push(i, e + 2, 'c'); i = e + 2; }
      continue;
    }
    if (c === '"' || c === "'") {
      let j = i + 1; while (j < end && s[j] !== c && s[j] !== '\n') { if (s[j] === '\\') j++; j++; }
      j = Math.min(j, end);
      if (j < end && s[j] === c) { out.push(i, j + 1, 's'); i = j + 1; } else { out.push(i, j, 'se'); i = j; }
      continue;
    }
    if (c === '{') { stack.push(/^\s*@(media|supports|document|layer|container|-?[a-z]*-?keyframes)/i.test(s.slice(pre, i)) ? 'g' : 'd'); inVal = false; i++; pre = i; continue; }
    if (c === '}') { stack.pop(); inVal = false; i++; pre = i; continue; }
    if (c === ';') { inVal = false; i++; pre = i; continue; }
    const mode = stack.length ? stack[stack.length - 1] : 'g';
    if (mode === 'd') {
      if (!inVal) {
        RE_CSSID.lastIndex = i; const m = RE_CSSID.exec(s);
        if (m && m.index === i) {
          let q = i + m[0].length; while (s[q] === ' ' || s[q] === '\n' || s[q] === '\t') q++;
          if (s[q] === ':') { out.push(i, i + m[0].length, 'pr'); i = q + 1; inVal = true; continue; }
          i += m[0].length; continue;
        }
        i++; continue;
      }
      if (c === '#' && at(RE_HEX, 'n')) continue;
      if (c === '!' && at(RE_IMP, 'k')) continue;
      if (((c >= '0' && c <= '9') || c === '.' || (c === '-' && /[\d.]/.test(s[i + 1] || ''))) && at(RE_CNUM, 'n')) continue;
      RE_CIDENT.lastIndex = i; const m2 = RE_CIDENT.exec(s);
      if (m2 && m2.index === i) { const e = i + m2[0].length; if (s[e] === '(') out.push(i, e, 'f'); i = e; continue; }
      i++; continue;
    }
    if (c === '@' && at(RE_AT, 'k')) continue;
    if ((c === '.' || c === '#') && at(RE_CCLS, 'cl')) continue;
    if (c === ':' && at(RE_PSEUDO, 'k')) continue;
    if (at(RE_TAGN, 'tg')) continue;
    i++;
  }
}
const RE_TAG = /<\/?([a-zA-Z][\w:-]*)/y, RE_ATTR = /[^\s=>\/"']+/y, RE_UNQ = /[^\s>]+/y;
function tokHTML(s, i, end, out) {
  while (i < end) {
    const lt = s.indexOf('<', i); if (lt < 0 || lt >= end) break;
    if (s.startsWith('<!--', lt)) { let e = s.indexOf('-->', lt + 4); e = (e < 0 || e + 3 > end) ? end : e + 3; out.push(lt, e, 'c'); i = e; continue; }
    if (s[lt + 1] === '!' || s[lt + 1] === '?') { let e = s.indexOf('>', lt); e = (e < 0 || e >= end) ? end : e + 1; out.push(lt, e, 'k'); i = e; continue; }
    RE_TAG.lastIndex = lt; const m = RE_TAG.exec(s);
    if (!m || m.index !== lt) { i = lt + 1; continue; }
    const name = m[1].toLowerCase(), closing = m[0][1] === '/';
    out.push(lt, lt + m[0].length, 'tg');
    let j = lt + m[0].length, attrType = '', selfClosed = false;
    while (j < end) {
      const c = s[j];
      if (c === ' ' || c === '\n' || c === '\t' || c === '\r') { j++; continue; }
      if (c === '>') { out.push(j, j + 1, 'tg'); j++; break; }
      if (c === '/' && s[j + 1] === '>') { out.push(j, j + 2, 'tg'); j += 2; selfClosed = true; break; }
      RE_ATTR.lastIndex = j; const a = RE_ATTR.exec(s);
      if (!a || a.index !== j) { j++; continue; }
      out.push(j, j + a[0].length, 'at'); const an = a[0].toLowerCase(); j += a[0].length;
      let q = j; while (s[q] === ' ') q++;
      if (s[q] === '=') {
        j = q + 1; while (s[j] === ' ') j++;
        const v = s[j];
        if (v === '"' || v === "'") {
          let e = s.indexOf(v, j + 1); e = (e < 0 || e >= end) ? end : e + 1;
          out.push(j, e, 's'); if (an === 'type') attrType = s.slice(j + 1, e - 1).toLowerCase(); j = e;
        } else {
          RE_UNQ.lastIndex = j; const u = RE_UNQ.exec(s);
          if (u && u.index === j) { out.push(j, j + u[0].length, 's'); if (an === 'type') attrType = u[0].toLowerCase(); j += u[0].length; }
        }
      }
    }
    i = j;
    if (!closing && !selfClosed && (name === 'script' || name === 'style')) {
      const re = new RegExp('</' + name, 'ig'); re.lastIndex = i;
      const cm = re.exec(s); const ce = (cm && cm.index < end) ? cm.index : end;
      if (name === 'style') tokCSS(s, i, ce, out);
      else if (/json/.test(attrType)) tokJSON(s, i, ce, out);
      else if (!attrType || /javascript|module|ecmascript/.test(attrType)) tokJS(s, i, ce, out, false);
      i = ce;
    }
  }
}
function langOf(name) {
  const e = (String(name).split('.').pop() || '').toLowerCase();
  return { js: 'js', gs: 'js', mjs: 'js', jsx: 'js', ts: 'js', html: 'html', htm: 'html', xml: 'html', svg: 'html', css: 'css', json: 'json' }[e] || 'plain';
}
function tokenize(text, lang) {
  const out = [];
  if (lang === 'plain' || text.length > MAX_HL) return out;
  try {
    if (lang === 'js') tokJS(text, 0, text.length, out, false);
    else if (lang === 'html') tokHTML(text, 0, text.length, out);
    else if (lang === 'css') tokCSS(text, 0, text.length, out);
    else if (lang === 'json') tokJSON(text, 0, text.length, out);
  } catch (e) { return []; }
  return out;
}
function lineIn(text, pos) { let n = 1, i = -1; while ((i = text.indexOf('\n', i + 1)) !== -1 && i < pos) n++; return n; }
function lintText(text, tk, lang) {
  const iss = [];
  if (lang === 'json') {
    if (!text.trim()) return iss;
    try { JSON.parse(text); } catch (e) { const m = /position\s+(\d+)/.exec(e.message); iss.push({ line: m ? lineIn(text, +m[1]) : 1, msg: 'JSON: ' + String(e.message).slice(0, 90) }); }
    return iss;
  }
  if (lang !== 'js' && lang !== 'css') return iss;
  const stack = [], pairs = { ')': '(', ']': '[', '}': '{' };
  const scan = (a, b) => {
    for (let p = a; p < b; p++) {
      const c = text[p];
      if (c === '(' || c === '[' || c === '{') stack.push([c, p]);
      else if (c === ')' || c === ']' || c === '}') {
        const top = stack.pop();
        if (!top) iss.push({ line: lineIn(text, p), pos: p, msg: 'إغلاق زائد «' + c + '»' });
        else if (top[0] !== pairs[c]) iss.push({ line: lineIn(text, p), pos: p, msg: '«' + c + '» لا يطابق «' + top[0] + '» (فُتح في سطر ' + lineIn(text, top[1]) + ')' });
      }
    }
  };
  let i = 0;
  for (let k = 0; k < tk.length; k += 3) {
    scan(i, tk[k]);
    if (tk[k + 2] === 'se') iss.push({ line: lineIn(text, tk[k]), pos: tk[k], msg: 'نص أو تعليق غير مغلق' });
    i = tk[k + 1];
  }
  scan(i, text.length);
  stack.forEach(([c, p]) => iss.push({ line: lineIn(text, p), pos: p, msg: '«' + c + '» غير مغلق' }));
  return iss.slice(0, 50);
}

  o = o || {};

function locateHint(content, find) {

function findNearMatch(content, text) {
  if (!text) return null;
  const ci = content.toLowerCase().indexOf(text.toLowerCase());
  if (ci >= 0) return { type: 'case', text: content.substring(ci, ci + text.length), index: ci };
  const escaped = text.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, '\\$&');
  try { const m = content.match(new RegExp(escaped.replace(/\s+/g, '\\s+'), 'i')); if (m) return { type: 'whitespace', text: m[0], index: m.index }; } catch (e) { }

}
function stripFences(s) { return s.replace(/^\s*```[a-zA-Z]*[ \t]*\n?/, '').replace(/\n?```\s*$/, ''); }
function repairJSON(raw) {
  let out = '', inStr = false, esc = false;
  for (const ch of raw) {
    if (inStr) {
      if (esc) { out += ch; esc = false; continue; }
      if (ch === '\\') { out += ch; esc = true; continue; }
      if (ch === '"') { out += ch; inStr = false; continue; }
      if (ch === '\n') { out += '\\n'; continue; }
      if (ch === '\r') { continue; }
      if (ch === '\t') { out += '\\t'; continue; }
      out += ch;
    } else {
      if (ch === '"') inStr = true;
      if (ch === ']' || ch === '}') out = out.replace(/,\s*$/, '');
      out += ch;
    }
  }
  return out;
}

function parsePatches(raw) {

  let data, repaired = false, cleaned = false;

  catch (e1) {
    try { data = JSON.parse(repairJSON(s)); repaired = true; }
    catch (e2) { try { data = JSON.parse(repairJSON(cleanPatchText(s))); repaired = true; cleaned = true; } catch (e3) { throw makeError('JSON_PARSE_ERROR', 'خطأ في صيغة JSON', { message: e1.message + jsonErrLoc(s, e1) }); } }

}
function findMatches(hay, needle, flex) {
  const out = []; let i = 0;
  while ((i = hay.indexOf(needle, i)) !== -1) { out.push({ i, len: needle.length }); i += Math.max(1, needle.length); }
  if (out.length || !flex) return { list: out, flex: false };
  const t = needle.trim(); if (!t) return { list: [], flex: false };
  const parts = t.split(/\s+/).map(x => x.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, '\\$&'));

  let m;
  while ((m = re.exec(hay))) { out.push({ i: m.index, len: m[0].length }); if (!m[0].length) re.lastIndex++; }

}
function alreadyDone(w, m, act, nt, ft) {
  if (!nt) return false;
  if (act === 'insert_after') return w.substr(m.i + m.len, nt.length) === nt;
  if (act === 'insert_before') return m.i >= nt.length && w.substr(m.i - nt.length, nt.length) === nt;
  if (act === 'replace') {
    let o = -1;
    while ((o = nt.indexOf(ft, o + 1)) !== -1) { if (m.i - o >= 0 && w.substr(m.i - o, nt.length) === nt) return true; }
  }
  return false;
}
const ACTIONS = ['replace', 'insert_after', 'insert_before', 'append', 'prepend', 'delete'];
const NEEDS_FIND = ['replace', 'insert_after', 'insert_before', 'delete'];

function evaluatePatches(content, patches, opts) {
  opts = opts || {};
  const results = []; let working = content;
  patches.forEach((p, i) => {
    const n = i + 1; let act = 'replace';
    const push = (status, extra) => results.push(Object.assign({ n, action: act, status }, extra || {}));
    const fail = (code, title, o) => push('failed', { error: makeError(code, title + ' #' + n, Object.assign({ patchIndex: n, action: act }, o || {})) });

    if (!p || typeof p !== 'object' || Array.isArray(p)) return fail('PATCH_INVALID', 'باتش غير صالح', { message: 'يجب أن يكون الباتش كائناً' });
    if (p.action !== undefined) {
      if (typeof p.action !== 'string') return fail('PATCH_ACTION', 'حقل action غير صالح');
      act = p.action.trim().toLowerCase();
    }
    if (!ACTIONS.includes(act)) return fail('PATCH_ACTION', 'عملية غير معروفة', { message: 'المتاح: ' + ACTIONS.join(', ') });
    const find = typeof p.find === 'string' ? nl(p.find) : '';
    const rawNew = typeof p.replace === 'string' ? p.replace : (typeof p.content === 'string' ? p.content : null);
    const hasNew = rawNew !== null, nt = hasNew ? nl(rawNew) : '';

    if (NEEDS_NEW.includes(act) && !hasNew) return fail('PATCH_INVALID', 'حقل replace/content مفقود');

    if (act === 'append') {

      const bf0 = working, at0 = working.length; working += nt; return push('applied', { line: lineOf(working, working.length - nt.length), ex: { b: '', a: nt.slice(0, 1500) }, bf: bf0, ed: [{ at: at0, del: '', ins: nt }] });
    }
    if (act === 'prepend') {
      if (!nt || working.startsWith(nt)) return push('skipped', { reason: nt ? 'مطبق مسبقاً' : 'نص فارغ' });
      const bf0 = working; working = nt + working; return push('applied', { line: 1, ex: { b: '', a: nt.slice(0, 1500) }, bf: bf0, ed: [{ at: 0, del: '', ins: nt }] });
    }

      if (near) return fail('PATCH_NEAR_MISS', 'نص مشابه', { message: 'البحث الحرفي فشل، لكن وُجد نص مشابه في السطر ' + lineOf(working, near.index), searchText: find, similarMatch: near.text, similarLine: lineOf(working, near.index), suggestion: 'انسخ النص من المحرر حرفياً', severity: 'warn' });
      if (delLike) return push('skipped', { reason: 'غير موجود (محذوف مسبقاً؟)' });

      return fail('PATCH_NOT_FOUND', 'لم يُعثر على النص', Object.assign({ searchText: find, message: nb }, hint ? { similarMatch: hint.text, similarLine: hint.line, suggestion: 'وُجد سطر من النص المطلوب في سطر ' + hint.line + ' — افتحه في المحرر وعدّل يدوياً' } : {}));
    }
    const remaining = list.filter(m => !alreadyDone(working, m, act, nt, find));
    if (!remaining.length) return push('skipped', { reason: 'مطبق مسبقاً' });
    let targets;
    if (p.all === true) targets = remaining;
    else if (p.occurrence !== undefined) {
      const k = Number(p.occurrence);
      if (!Number.isInteger(k) || k < 1 || k > list.length) return fail('PATCH_OCCURRENCE', 'رقم occurrence غير صالح', { message: 'عدد التطابقات: ' + list.length, searchText: find });
      if (alreadyDone(working, list[k - 1], act, nt, find)) return push('skipped', { reason: 'مطبق مسبقاً' });

      return fail('PATCH_AMBIGUOUS', 'النص مكرر', { message: 'وُجد ' + remaining.length + ' تطابقات (الأسطر: ' + lines + (remaining.length > 8 ? '…' : '') + ')', searchText: find, severity: 'warn', suggestion: 'اجعل find أطول ليصبح فريداً، أو أضف "all":true أو "occurrence":رقم' });

      else working = working.slice(0, m.i) + nt + working.slice(m.i + m.len);
    });
    push('applied', { line: firstLine, count: targets.length, flex: res.flex, ex: { b: exB, a: nt.slice(0, 1500) }, bf: bfX, ed: edX });
  });
  return { results, output: working };
}
function diffRange(a, b) {
  const la = a.length, lb = b.length, m = Math.min(la, lb);
  let p = 0; while (p < m && a.charCodeAt(p) === b.charCodeAt(p)) p++;
  let q = 0; while (q < m - p && a.charCodeAt(la - 1 - q) === b.charCodeAt(lb - 1 - q)) q++;
  return { at: p, del: a.slice(p, la - q), ins: b.slice(p, lb - q) };
}

function vis(s) { return String(s).replace(/\n/g, '↵').replace(/\t/g, '→').replace(/ /g, '[NBSP]').replace(/[​-‏﻿‪-‮]/g, '[خفي]'); }
function rFence(t) { return FENCE + '\n' + t + '\n' + FENCE; }
function rLines(content, a, b, n) {
  const L = String(content).split('\n'), s = Math.max(1, a - n), e = Math.min(L.length, b + n), w = String(e).length, o = [];
  for (let i = s; i <= e; i++) o.push(String(i).padStart(w) + (i >= a && i <= b ? '>' : ' ') + ' ' + truncate(L[i - 1], 220));
  return o.join('\n');
}
function rHints(content, find) {
  const L = String(content).split('\n'), out = [], seen = new Set();
  const add = (i, why) => { if (out.length < 3 && !seen.has(i)) { seen.add(i); out.push({ line: i + 1, why }); } };
  const fl = nl(find).split('\n').map(x => x.trim()).filter(x => x.length >= 6).sort((a, b) => b.length - a.length);
  for (const t of fl.slice(0, 3)) { L.forEach((l, i) => { if (l.includes(t)) add(i, 'يحوي السطر «' + truncate(t, 50) + '»'); }); if (out.length) break; }
  if (!out.length) {
    const words = (find.match(/[A-Za-z_$][\w$]{4,}/g) || []).filter((w, i, a) => a.indexOf(w) === i).sort((a, b) => b.length - a.length).slice(0, 3);
    for (const w of words) { L.forEach((l, i) => { if (l.includes(w)) add(i, 'يحوي الكلمة «' + w + '»'); }); if (out.length) break; }
  }
  return out;
}
function rOutline(content) {

function rWhatDiff(a, b) {
  let why;
  if (a.toLowerCase() === b.toLowerCase()) why = 'الفرق في حالة الأحرف (كبيرة/صغيرة).';
  else if (a.replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim() === b.replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim()) why = 'الفرق في المسافات أو التبويب أو فواصل الأسطر.';
  else why = 'جزء من النص يطابق والباقي يختلف.';

      }
    } else if (err.code === 'PATCH_AMBIGUOUS' || err.code === 'PATCH_OCCURRENCE') {
      const hits = []; let p = content.indexOf(find);
      while (p >= 0 && hits.length < 8) { hits.push(p); p = content.indexOf(find, p + Math.max(1, find.length)); }
      if (hits.length) {
        L.push('', '### مواضع التكرار في الكود الفعلي (' + hits.length + (hits.length >= 8 ? '+' : '') + '):');
        hits.forEach((h, i) => { const ln = content.slice(0, h).split('\n').length; L.push('الموضع ' + (i + 1) + ' — سطر ' + ln + ':', rFence(rLines(content, ln, ln + nLines - 1, 2))); });
        L.push('الحل: أطِل find بإضافة سطر مجاور يجعله فريداً، أو أضف "occurrence": رقم الموضع، أو "all": true.');
      }

      if (hs.length) {

        hs.forEach(h => L.push('- سطر ' + h.line + ' — ' + h.why));
        hs.slice(0, 2).forEach(h => L.push('', 'الكود الفعلي حول سطر ' + h.line + ':', rFence(rLines(content, h.line, h.line + nLines - 1, 4))));
      } else {
        const ol = rOutline(content);
        L.push('', '### لم أجد في الملف أي سطر يشبه النص المطلوب. مخطط الملف الفعلي (' + content.split('\n').length + ' سطراً):', rFence(ol.length ? ol.join('\n') : rLines(content, 1, 25, 0)));
      }

  if (err.code === 'FILE_NOT_FOUND' || err.code === 'FILE_AMBIGUOUS') L.push('', '### ملفات المشروع الحالية:', rFence(cx.files.slice(0, 60).join('\n')));

function smokeSection(cx) {

}
function repairReportText(errs, cx) {
  const ev = cx.ev, out = [];
  out.push('=== تقرير إصلاح للذكاء — CodePatcher ===');

function lineAt(p) {

}
function runLint() {

function updateLintStatus() {

  const label = { js: 'JS', html: 'HTML', css: 'CSS', json: 'JSON', plain: 'TXT' }[lang];

  if (doc.lint.length) { el.className = 'tap bad'; el.innerHTML = label + ' ' + ic('alert', 'xs') + ' ' + doc.lint.length; }
  else { el.className = 'tap good'; el.innerHTML = label + ' ' + ic('check', 'xs'); }
}

function lineHTML(L) {
  const t = doc.text, tk = doc.tk, nT = tk.length / 3;
  const ls = doc.ls[L], le = L + 1 < doc.n ? doc.ls[L + 1] - 1 : t.length;
  let pos = ls, h = '';
  let lo = 0, hi = nT;
  while (lo < hi) { const mid = (lo + hi) >> 1; if (tk[mid * 3 + 1] <= ls) lo = mid + 1; else hi = mid; }
  for (let q = lo; q < nT && tk[q * 3] < le; q++) {

      h += `<span class="t-${tk[q * 3 + 2]}">${escM(ts, te)}</span>`; pos = te;
    }
  }
  if (pos < le) h += escM(pos, le);
  return h;
}
function paintWindow() {

function revealCaret() {

function pushHist(f, d, barrier) {

  f.redo = [];

function parseBundle(raw) {

      while (k < L.length && (!L[k].trim() || /^\s*#( |$)/.test(L[k]) || /^\s*```\s*$/.test(L[k]))) k++;
      const inner = L.slice(j, e).some(l => { const m2 = bundleMark(l); return m2 && m2.n != null; });
      if (e <= L.length && !inner && (k >= L.length || bundleMark(L[k]))) { body = L.slice(j, e).join('\n'); next = k; }
    }
    if (body === null) {
      const q = nextMark(j); body = L.slice(j, q).join('\n'); next = q;
      if (/^\s*```/.test(body)) body = stripFences(body);
      if (mk.n != null) { const got = body.replace(/\s+$/, '') ? body.replace(/\s+$/, '').split('\n').length : 0; warn = 'متوقع ' + mk.n + ' سطر ووُجد ' + got + ' (ربما قُطع أو عُدّل النص)'; }
    }
    const t = body.replace(/\s+$/, '');
    out.push({ name: mk.name, content: t ? t + '\n' : (mk.n === 0 ? '' : '\n'), warn });
    i = next;
  }
  return out;
}
function parseInput(raw) {
  const t = stripFences(String(raw || '').trim());
  if (/^[\[{]/.test(t)) return parsePatches(raw);
  const b = parseBundle(raw);
  if (b) return { bundle: b, repaired: false };
  return parsePatches(raw);
}
function resolveFile(ref, work, def) {
  if (!ref) return { name: def !== undefined ? def : cur().name };
  const r = String(ref).trim().replace(/^(\.\/)+/, '').replace(/^\//, '');
  if (work[r] !== undefined) return { name: r };
  const base = r.split('/').pop();
  const m = Object.keys(work).filter(n => n.split('/').pop() === base);
  if (m.length === 1) return { name: m[0] };
  if (m.length > 1) return { err: 1, list: m };
  return { none: r };
}
function putFileResult(work, n, ref, content, overwrite, action) {
  const r = resolveFile(ref, work);
  if (r.err) return { n, action, file: ref, status: 'failed', error: makeError('FILE_AMBIGUOUS', 'اسم الملف ملتبس #' + n, { patchIndex: n, action, message: r.list.join(' ، '), suggestion: 'اكتب المسار الكامل' }) };
  const name = r.name || String(ref || '').trim().replace(/^(\.\/)+/, '').replace(/^\//, '');
  if (!name) return { n, action, file: '', status: 'failed', error: makeError('PATCH_INVALID', 'اسم الملف فارغ #' + n, { patchIndex: n, action }) };
  if (work[name] === content) return { n, action, file: name, status: 'skipped', reason: 'مطبق مسبقاً' };
  if (r.name && !overwrite) return { n, action, file: name, status: 'failed', error: makeError('FILE_EXISTS', 'الملف موجود #' + n, { patchIndex: n, action, message: name, suggestion: 'أضف "overwrite":true للاستبدال الكامل' }) };
  const prev = work[name] === undefined ? '' : work[name];
  work[name] = content;
  return { n, action, file: name, status: 'applied', line: 1, info: r.name ? 'استبدال كامل' : 'ملف جديد', ex: { b: '', a: content.slice(0, 160) }, bf: prev, af: content, full: 1 };
}
/* ===== H2: القبول الجزئي ===== */
let REJ = new Set(), REJ_KEY = '', PDOPEN = new Set(), lastEv = null, lastDry = true;
function rejSync(txt) { if (txt !== REJ_KEY) { REJ = new Set(); REJ_KEY = txt; PDOPEN = new Set(); } }
function clearPatchUI() { $('patchSummary').innerHTML = ''; $('patchList').innerHTML = ''; $('smokeBox').innerHTML = ''; }
function runCore(parsed, work, def, opts, rej) {
  const before = Object.assign({}, work), results = [];
  const scratch = () => Object.assign({}, work);
  if (parsed.bundle) {
    parsed.bundle.forEach((b, i) => {
      const n = i + 1;
      if (rej.has(n)) { const r = putFileResult(scratch(), n, b.name, b.content, true, 'file'); if (r.status === 'applied') r.status = 'rejected'; return results.push(r); }
      results.push(putFileResult(work, n, b.name, b.content, true, 'file'));
    });
  } else {
    parsed.patches.forEach((p, i) => {
      const n = i + 1;
      const bad = (code, title, o) => results.push({ n, action: (p && typeof p.action === 'string' ? p.action : 'replace'), file: p && p.file, status: 'failed', error: makeError(code, title + ' #' + n, Object.assign({ patchIndex: n, file: (p && typeof p === 'object') ? p.file : undefined }, o || {})) });
      if (!p || typeof p !== 'object' || Array.isArray(p)) return bad('PATCH_INVALID', 'باتش غير صالح');
      const act = typeof p.action === 'string' ? p.action.trim().toLowerCase() : 'replace';
      if (act === 'create') {
        const c = typeof p.content === 'string' ? p.content : (typeof p.replace === 'string' ? p.replace : null);
        if (!p.file) return bad('PATCH_INVALID', 'حقل file مفقود');
        if (c === null) return bad('PATCH_INVALID', 'حقل content مفقود');
        if (rej.has(n)) { const r = putFileResult(scratch(), n, p.file, nl(c), p.overwrite === true, 'create'); if (r.status === 'applied') r.status = 'rejected'; return results.push(r); }
        return results.push(putFileResult(work, n, p.file, nl(c), p.overwrite === true, 'create'));
      }
      const r = resolveFile(p.file, work, def);
      if (r.err) return bad('FILE_AMBIGUOUS', 'اسم الملف ملتبس', { message: r.list.join(' ، '), suggestion: 'اكتب المسار الكامل' });
      if (r.none) return bad('FILE_NOT_FOUND', 'الملف غير موجود', { message: r.none, suggestion: 'أنشئه أولاً بـ action:"create"' });
      const one = evaluatePatches(work[r.name], [p], opts), ev = one.results[0];
      ev.n = n; ev.file = r.name;
      if (ev.error) { ev.error.patchIndex = n; ev.error.title = ev.error.title.replace(/#1$/, '#' + n); ev.error.message = '[' + r.name + '] ' + (ev.error.message || ''); ev.error.file = r.name; ev.error.intended = typeof p.replace === 'string' ? p.replace : (typeof p.content === 'string' ? p.content : ''); }
      if (ev.status === 'applied') { if (rej.has(n)) ev.status = 'rejected'; else work[r.name] = one.output; }
      results.push(ev);
    });
  }
  const failed = results.filter(r => r.status === 'failed').length;
  const ev = { results, work, before, failed, blocked: opts.atomic && failed > 0, repaired: parsed.repaired, kind: kindLabel(parsed) };
  ev.changed = Object.keys(work).filter(k => work[k] !== before[k]);
  ev.lazy = lazyScan(parsed, before, rej);
  if (!ev.blocked) {
    let reg = 0;
    ev.changed.forEach(k => {
      const lang = langOf(k); if (lang !== 'js' && lang !== 'css' && lang !== 'json') return;
      const b = before[k] === undefined ? 0 : lintText(before[k], tokenize(before[k], lang), lang).length;
      const a = lintText(work[k], tokenize(work[k], lang), lang).length;
      if (a > b) reg += a - b;
    });
    if (reg) ev.regress = reg;
  }
  return ev;
}
function addedText(r) { return r.ed ? r.ed.map(e => e.ins).join('\n') : (r.af || ''); }
function h2Deps(part, full, beforeAll) {
  const deps = [], coupling = [], rejRows = part.results.filter(r => r.status === 'rejected');
  if (!rejRows.length) return { deps, coupling };
  part.results.forEach((r, i) => {
    const f = full.results[i]; if (!f || f.status !== 'applied') return;
    const changed = (r.status === 'failed' || r.status === 'skipped') || (r.status === 'applied' && r.count !== f.count);
    if (!changed) return;
    const same = rejRows.filter(x => x.n < r.n && x.file === r.file), on = (same.length ? same : rejRows.filter(x => x.n < r.n)).map(x => x.n);
    if (on.length) deps.push({ n: r.n, on, why: r.status === 'applied' ? 'تغيّر عدد المواضع المطابقة' : 'لم يعد يُطبَّق' });
  });
  const idRe = /[A-Za-z_$][\w$]{3,}/g;
  rejRows.forEach(j => {
    const ids = {}; (addedText(j).match(idRe) || []).forEach(x => { if (Object.keys(ids).length < 30) ids[x] = 1; });
    const fresh = Object.keys(ids).filter(x => beforeAll.indexOf(x) < 0);
    if (!fresh.length) return;
    part.results.forEach(k => {
      if (k.status !== 'applied' || k.n === j.n) return;
      const t = addedText(k), hit = fresh.find(x => t.indexOf(x) >= 0);
      if (hit && coupling.length < 6) coupling.push('#' + k.n + ' يستخدم «' + hit + '» المُضاف في #' + j.n + ' المرفوض');
    });
  });
  return { deps, coupling };
}
function evalWithRej(parsed, work, def, opts, rej) {
  const w0 = Object.assign({}, work);
  const ev = runCore(parsed, Object.assign({}, work), def, opts, rej);
  if (rej.size) {
    const full = runCore(parsed, Object.assign({}, work), def, opts, new Set());
    const d = h2Deps(ev, full, Object.keys(w0).map(k => w0[k]).join('\n'));
    ev.deps = d.deps; ev.coupling = d.coupling;
  }
  return ev;
}
function runPatchEngine() {
  const f0 = cur();
  if (!f0) { clearPatchUI(); renderErrors([makeError('NO_FILE', 'لا يوجد ملف مفتوح')]); return null; }
  let parsed;
  try { parsed = parseInput($('patchInput').value); }
  catch (e) { clearPatchUI(); renderErrors([e && e.code ? e : makeError('PARSE_FAIL', 'خطأ', { message: e && e.message })]); return null; }
  rejSync($('patchInput').value);
  const opts = { flex: $('optFlex').checked, atomic: $('optAtomic').checked };
  const work = {}; files.forEach(f => { work[f.name] = f.content; }); work[f0.name] = editor.value;
  const ev = evalWithRej(parsed, work, f0.name, opts, REJ);
  if (parsed.cleaned) log('ok', 'نُظّف الباتش من اقتباسات ذكية/أحرف خفية قبل التحليل');
  return ev;
}
function commitProject(ev) {
  const act = cur(), items = [];
  ev.changed.forEach(name => {
    const nv = ev.work[name]; let f = files.find(x => x.name === name);
    if (!f) { f = makeFile(name, nv, ''); files.push(f); items.push({ id: f.id, isNew: true, after: nv }); return; }
    items.push({ id: f.id, before: f.content, after: nv });
    if (f.id !== act.id) { pushHist(f, diffRange(f.content, nv), true); f.content = nv; f.dirtySave = true; }
  });
  if (ev.changed.includes(act.name)) setAll(ev.work[act.name]);
  lastBatch = { items };
  render(); scheduleSave();
}
function undoBatch() {
  const b = lastBatch; if (!b) return toast('لا يوجد تطبيق للتراجع عنه');
  const stale = b.items.some(it => { const f = files.find(x => x.id === it.id); return !f || f.content !== it.after; });
  if (stale) { lastBatch = null; return toast('تغيّرت الملفات بعد التطبيق — استخدم تراجع المحرر', 'err'); }
  lastBatch = null;
  b.items.forEach(it => {
    const f = files.find(x => x.id === it.id); if (!f) return;
    if (it.isNew) { files = files.filter(x => x !== f); removedIds.push(f.id); return; }
    if (f.id === activeId) { undo(); return; }
    f.undo.pop(); f.redo = []; f.content = it.before; f.dirtySave = true;
  });
  if (!files.some(f => f.id === activeId)) activeId = files.length ? files[0].id : null;
  render(); scheduleSave(); toast('تم التراجع عن آخر تطبيق', 'ok');
}
/* يحلّ الرابط بالنسبة لمجلد ملف الدخول (fromDir) حتى لا تختلط المشاريع المتجاورة.
   البحث بالاسم وحده لا يُستعمل إلا إن كان الاسم فريداً، ولا يُخمَّن عند وجود أكثر من ملف بنفس الاسم. */
function refFile(ref, fromDir) {
  if (/^([a-z][a-z0-9+.-]*:|\/\/)/i.test(ref)) return null;
  const clean = String(ref).split(/[?#]/)[0], abs = clean[0] === '/';
  const b = clean.replace(/^(\.\/)+/, '').replace(/^\//, '');
  if (!b) return null;
  fromDir = fromDir || '';
  const rel = normPath(abs ? b : (fromDir ? fromDir + '/' : '') + b);
  let f = rel != null ? files.find(x => x.name === rel) : null;
  if (f) return f;
  if (abs) { f = files.find(x => x.name === b); if (f) return f; }
  const base = b.split('/').pop(), same = files.filter(x => x.name.split('/').pop() === base);
  if (same.length === 1) return same[0];
  const inTree = fromDir ? same.filter(x => x.name.startsWith(fromDir + '/')) : same;
  return inTree.length === 1 ? inTree[0] : null;
}
/* ملف الدخول: index.html في مجلد الملف النشط، ثم في المجلدات الأعلى، ثم أي html في المجلد نفسه */
function pickEntry(f) {
  if (f.lang === 'html') return f;
  const htmls = files.filter(x => x.lang === 'html');
  let d = dirOf(f.name);
  for (;;) {
    const hit = htmls.find(x => dirOf(x.name) === d && /(^|\/)index\.html?$/i.test(x.name)) || htmls.find(x => dirOf(x.name) === d);
    if (hit) return hit;
    if (!d) break;
    d = dirOf(d);
  }
  return files.find(x => /(^|\/)index\.html?$/i.test(x.name)) || htmls[0] || f;
}
function projectSource() {
  const f = cur(); if (!f) return '';
  let entry = f;
  if (f.lang !== 'html') entry = pickEntry(f);
  const eDir = dirOf(entry.name);
  const src = entry.id === f.id ? editor.value : entry.content;
  if (entry.lang !== 'html') return src;
  const deferred = [];
  let out = src.replace(/<link\b[^>]*>/gi, m => {
    if (!/rel\s*=\s*["']?stylesheet/i.test(m)) return m;
    const h = /href\s*=\s*["']([^"']+)["']/i.exec(m), pf = h && refFile(h[1], eDir);
    return pf && pf !== entry ? '<style>' + pf.content + '</style>' : m;
  });
  out = out.replace(/<script\b([^>]*)>\s*<\/script>/gi, (m, attrs) => {
    const s = /\bsrc\s*=\s*["']([^"']+)["']/i.exec(attrs); if (!s) return m;
    const pf = refFile(s[1], eDir); if (!pf || pf === entry) return m;
    const isDefer = /\bdefer\b/i.test(attrs) && !/type\s*=\s*["']?module/i.test(attrs);
    const a = attrs.replace(/\bsrc\s*=\s*["'][^"']*["']/i, '').replace(/\s+(defer|async)\b/gi, '');
    const tag = '<script' + a + '>' + pf.content.replace(/<\/script/gi, '<\\/script') + '<\/script>';
    if (isDefer) { deferred.push(tag); return ''; }
    return tag;
  });
  if (deferred.length) out = /<\/body>/i.test(out) ? out.replace(/<\/body>/i, () => deferred.join('\n') + '</body>') : out + deferred.join('\n');
  return out;
}

function rowInfo(r) {
  if (r.status === 'applied') return (r.info ? r.info + ' · ' : '') + 'سطر ' + r.line + (r.count > 1 ? ' × ' + r.count : '') + (r.flex ? ' · مطابقة مرنة' : '');
  if (r.status === 'rejected') return 'مرفوض بقرارك — لن يُطبَّق' + (r.line ? ' (سطر ' + r.line + ')' : '');
  if (r.status === 'skipped') return r.reason || '';
  return r.error ? r.error.title : '';
}
function exHTML(r) {
  if (r.status !== 'applied' || !r.ex) return '';
  const fmt = (t, c, sg) => { const L = String(t).split('\n'); let o = L.slice(0, 6).map(x => `<div class="${c}">${sg} ${esc(truncate(x, 110))}</div>`).join(''); if (L.length > 6) o += `<div class="px-more">… +${L.length - 6} سطر</div>`; return o; };
  let h = '';
  if (r.ex.b) h += fmt(r.ex.b, 'del', '−');
  if (r.ex.a) h += fmt(r.ex.a, 'add', '+');
  return h ? `<div class="px">${h}</div>` : '';
}
/* ---- مقاطع الفروق (قبل/بعد مع سياق) ---- */
function hunksFromEdits(bf, ed, ctx) {
  ctx = ctx || 3;
  const BL = bf.split('\n'), out = [];
  ed.slice().sort((a, b) => a.at - b.at).forEach(e => {
    const ls = bf.lastIndexOf('\n', e.at - 1) + 1;
    let le = bf.indexOf('\n', e.at + e.del.length); if (le < 0) le = bf.length;
    const bl = bf.slice(ls, le).split('\n'), al = (bf.slice(ls, e.at) + e.ins + bf.slice(e.at + e.del.length, le)).split('\n');
    let k1 = 0; while (k1 < bl.length && k1 < al.length && bl[k1] === al[k1]) k1++;
    let k2 = 0; while (k2 < bl.length - k1 && k2 < al.length - k1 && bl[bl.length - 1 - k2] === al[al.length - 1 - k2]) k2++;
    const del = bl.slice(k1, bl.length - k2), add = al.slice(k1, al.length - k2);
    if (!del.length && !add.length) return;
    const d0 = bf.slice(0, ls).split('\n').length - 1 + k1;
    const ops = [];
    BL.slice(Math.max(0, d0 - ctx), d0).forEach(x => ops.push({ t: ' ', x }));
    del.forEach(x => ops.push({ t: '-', x })); add.forEach(x => ops.push({ t: '+', x }));
    BL.slice(d0 + del.length, d0 + del.length + ctx).forEach(x => ops.push({ t: ' ', x }));
    out.push({ ln: d0 + 1, ops });
  });
  return out;
}
function lineDiffHunks(a, b, ctx) {
  ctx = ctx || 3;
  const A = a === '' ? [] : a.split('\n'), B = b === '' ? [] : b.split('\n');
  let s = 0; while (s < A.length && s < B.length && A[s] === B[s]) s++;
  let e = 0; while (e < A.length - s && e < B.length - s && A[A.length - 1 - e] === B[B.length - 1 - e]) e++;
  const a2 = A.slice(s, A.length - e), b2 = B.slice(s, B.length - e), mid = [];
  if (!a2.length || !b2.length || a2.length * b2.length > 2500000) { a2.forEach(x => mid.push({ t: '-', x })); b2.forEach(x => mid.push({ t: '+', x })); }
  else {
    const n = a2.length, m = b2.length, W = m + 1, dp = new Uint16Array((n + 1) * W);
    for (let i = n - 1; i >= 0; i--) for (let j = m - 1; j >= 0; j--) dp[i * W + j] = a2[i] === b2[j] ? dp[(i + 1) * W + j + 1] + 1 : Math.max(dp[(i + 1) * W + j], dp[i * W + j + 1]);
    let i = 0, j = 0;
    while (i < n && j < m) { if (a2[i] === b2[j]) { mid.push({ t: ' ', x: a2[i] }); i++; j++; } else if (dp[(i + 1) * W + j] >= dp[i * W + j + 1]) { mid.push({ t: '-', x: a2[i++] }); } else { mid.push({ t: '+', x: b2[j++] }); } }
    while (i < n) mid.push({ t: '-', x: a2[i++] }); while (j < m) mid.push({ t: '+', x: b2[j++] });
  }
  const pre = A.slice(Math.max(0, s - ctx), s).map(x => ({ t: ' ', x })), post = A.slice(A.length - e, A.length - e + ctx).map(x => ({ t: ' ', x }));
  const ops = pre.concat(mid, post), aIdx = [];
  let ai = s - pre.length; ops.forEach(o => { aIdx.push(ai); if (o.t !== '+') ai++; });
  const ch = []; ops.forEach((o, k) => { if (o.t !== ' ') ch.push(k); });
  const hunks = []; if (!ch.length) return hunks;
  const close = (x, y) => { const from = Math.max(0, x - ctx), to = Math.min(ops.length - 1, y + ctx); hunks.push({ ln: aIdx[from] + 1, ops: ops.slice(from, to + 1) }); };
  let st = ch[0], pv = ch[0];
  for (let q = 1; q < ch.length; q++) { if (ch[q] - pv - 1 > 2 * ctx) { close(st, pv); st = ch[q]; } pv = ch[q]; }
  close(st, pv);
  return hunks;
}
function rowHunks(r) {
  if (r.full) return lineDiffHunks(r.bf || '', r.af || '');
  if (r.ed && typeof r.bf === 'string') return hunksFromEdits(r.bf, r.ed);
  return [];
}
function diffHTML(r) {
  const H = rowHunks(r); if (!H.length) return '<div class="dm">لا فروق للعرض</div>';
  let total = 0, h = '';
  for (let i = 0; i < H.length && i < 30 && total < 400; i++) {
    const hk = H[i]; h += `<div class="dh">مقطع ${i + 1}/${H.length} — سطر ${hk.ln}</div>`;
    hk.ops.slice(0, 80).forEach(o => { total++; h += `<div class="dl ${o.t === '+' ? 'add' : o.t === '-' ? 'del' : 'ctx'}">${o.t === ' ' ? '  ' : o.t + ' '}${esc(truncate(o.x, 160))}</div>`; });
    if (hk.ops.length > 80) h += `<div class="dm">… +${hk.ops.length - 80} سطر</div>`;
  }
  if (H.length > 30 || total >= 400) h += '<div class="dm">العرض مقتطع (حد 30 مقطعاً/400 سطر) — التطبيق نفسه لا يتأثر</div>';
  return h;
}
function renderPatchResults(ev, dryRun) {
  const rs = ev.results; lastEv = ev; lastDry = !!dryRun; $('smokeBox').innerHTML = ''; smokeSeq++;
  const applied = rs.filter(r => r.status === 'applied').length, skipped = rs.filter(r => r.status === 'skipped').length, failed = ev.failed, rejected = rs.filter(r => r.status === 'rejected').length;
  let html = `<div class="summary"><span class="badge applied">${ic('check', 'xs')} ${applied}</span><span class="badge skipped">${ic('skip', 'xs')} ${skipped}</span><span class="badge failed">${ic('x-circle', 'xs')} ${failed}</span>${rejected ? `<span class="badge rejected">${ic('skip', 'xs')} ${rejected}</span>` : ''}<span style="margin-right:auto;font-size:11px;color:var(--muted)">${dryRun ? 'معاينة' : 'تعديل'}</span></div>`;
  if (dryRun && applied > 0 && !ev.blocked) html += `<div class="srow" style="margin-top:6px"><button type="button" class="btn success" data-papply="1">${ic('check', 'xs')} تطبيق ${applied}</button></div>`;
  if (dryRun && (applied + rejected) > 1) html += `<div class="srow" style="margin-top:6px"><button type="button" class="pmini" data-pall="acc">قبول الكل</button><button type="button" class="pmini" data-pall="rej">رفض الكل</button></div>`;

function moveCaret(el, dir) {
  const v = el.value, len = v.length;
  const base = (dir === 'left' || dir === 'up') ? el.selectionStart : el.selectionEnd;
  let np = base;
  if (dir === 'left') np = Math.max(0, base - 1);
  else if (dir === 'right') np = Math.min(len, base + 1);
  else if (el.tagName === 'INPUT') np = dir === 'up' ? 0 : len;
  else {
    const ls = base === 0 ? 0 : v.lastIndexOf('\n', base - 1) + 1, col = base - ls;
    if (dir === 'up') {
      if (ls === 0) np = 0;
      else { const pls = ls <= 1 ? 0 : v.lastIndexOf('\n', ls - 2) + 1; np = Math.min(pls + col, ls - 1); }
    } else {
      const le = v.indexOf('\n', base);
      if (le === -1) np = len;
      else { const nle = v.indexOf('\n', le + 1); np = Math.min(le + 1 + col, nle === -1 ? len : nle); }
    }
  }
  el.setSelectionRange(np, np);
  if (el === editor) { onSel(); revealCaret(); }
}
function handleSym(x) {
  const el = symTarget(); if (el.disabled) return;
  if (el !== document.activeElement) el.focus({ preventScroll: true });
  const s = el.selectionStart, e = el.selectionEnd;
  if (x.k === 'dup' || x.k === 'dell' || x.k === 'mvup' || x.k === 'mvdn') { if (el === editor) lineOp(x.k); return; }

  if (x.k === 'undo') { undo(); return; } if (x.k === 'redo') { redo(); return; } if (x.k === 'pfind') { openDrawer('search'); return; }
  if (x.k === 'comment') { if (el === editor) toggleComment(); return; }
  if (x.k === 'tab') { if (el === editor && editor.value.slice(s, e).includes('\n')) indentLines(1); else put(el, '    '); return; }
  if (x.k === 'sel+' || x.k === 'sel-') { if (el === editor) selExpand(x.k === 'sel+' ? 1 : -1); return; }
  if (x.k) { moveCaret(el, x.k); return; }
  if (x.pair && e > s) { put(el, x.t[0] + el.value.slice(s, e) + x.t[1]); return; }
  put(el, x.t, x.pair ? 1 : (x.back || 0));
}

  document.body.style.top = (vv ? vv.offsetTop : 0) + 'px';

}

function readZipEntries(buf) {
  const dv = new DataView(buf), u8 = new Uint8Array(buf), out = [];
  let e = -1;
  for (let i = u8.length - 22; i >= Math.max(0, u8.length - 65557); i--) { if (dv.getUint32(i, true) === 0x06054b50) { e = i; break; } }
  if (e < 0) throw new Error('ملف ZIP غير صالح');

  const dec = new TextDecoder('utf-8');
  for (let k = 0; k < total; k++) {
    if (p + 46 > u8.length || dv.getUint32(p, true) !== 0x02014b50) break;
    const flag = dv.getUint16(p + 8, true), method = dv.getUint16(p + 10, true), csize = dv.getUint32(p + 20, true);
    const nlen = dv.getUint16(p + 28, true), xlen = dv.getUint16(p + 30, true), clen = dv.getUint16(p + 32, true), off = dv.getUint32(p + 42, true);
    const name = dec.decode(u8.subarray(p + 46, p + 46 + nlen));
    p += 46 + nlen + xlen + clen;
    out.push({
      name,
      async get() {
        if ((flag & 1) || csize === 0xFFFFFFFF || off === 0xFFFFFFFF) return null;
        if (dv.getUint32(off, true) !== 0x04034b50) return null;
        const st = off + 30 + dv.getUint16(off + 26, true) + dv.getUint16(off + 28, true);
        const data = u8.subarray(st, st + csize);
        if (method === 0) return data;
        if (method === 8) return inflateRaw(data);
        return null;
      }
    });
  }
  return out;
}

async function zipC(entries) {

  for (const en of entries) { if (en.data.length < 64) continue; try { const c = await deflateRaw(en.data); if (c.length < en.data.length * 0.95) { en.cdata = c; } } catch (e) { } }

function makeZip(entries) {
  const enc = new TextEncoder(), parts = [], cd = []; let off = 0, cdSize = 0;
  const d = new Date(), time = (d.getHours() << 11) | (d.getMinutes() << 5) | (d.getSeconds() >> 1), date = ((d.getFullYear() - 1980) << 9) | ((d.getMonth() + 1) << 5) | d.getDate();
  entries.forEach(en => {
    const nm = enc.encode(en.name), crc = crc32(en.data), sz = en.data.length, cz = en.cdata ? en.cdata.length : sz, mt = en.cdata ? 8 : 0;
    const lh = new DataView(new ArrayBuffer(30));
    lh.setUint32(0, 0x04034b50, true); lh.setUint16(4, 20, true); lh.setUint16(6, 0x0800, true); lh.setUint16(8, mt, true); lh.setUint16(10, time, true); lh.setUint16(12, date, true);
    lh.setUint32(14, crc, true); lh.setUint32(18, cz, true); lh.setUint32(22, sz, true); lh.setUint16(26, nm.length, true);
    parts.push(lh.buffer, nm, en.cdata || en.data);
    const ch = new DataView(new ArrayBuffer(46));
    ch.setUint32(0, 0x02014b50, true); ch.setUint16(4, 20, true); ch.setUint16(6, 20, true); ch.setUint16(8, 0x0800, true); ch.setUint16(10, mt, true); ch.setUint16(12, time, true); ch.setUint16(14, date, true);
    ch.setUint32(16, crc, true); ch.setUint32(20, cz, true); ch.setUint32(24, sz, true); ch.setUint16(28, nm.length, true); ch.setUint32(42, off, true);
    cd.push(ch.buffer, nm); cdSize += 46 + nm.length; off += 30 + nm.length + cz;
  });
  const eo = new DataView(new ArrayBuffer(22));
  eo.setUint32(0, 0x06054b50, true); eo.setUint16(8, entries.length, true); eo.setUint16(10, entries.length, true); eo.setUint32(12, cdSize, true); eo.setUint32(16, off, true);
  return new Blob([...parts, ...cd, eo.buffer], { type: 'application/zip' });
}

'use strict';
/* حزمة نصية واحدة: تصدير المشروع كنص + خريطة ملفات، واستيراد نص لتوليد الملفات.
   الصيغة:  === FILE: path (N lines) ===  ثم المحتوى. القراءة في parseBundle (12-patch-ui.js). */
const BUNDLE_HEAD = /^\s*# CodePatcher Bundle/;
/* بعد ui.close يلزم انتظار قصير قبل فتح نافذة أخرى (سباق history.back في ui) */
const bundleWait = ms => new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, ms));
const bundleOpt = { instr: true, limit: 0 };
const bLines = c => { const t = String(c).replace(/\s+$/, ''); return t === '' ? 0 : t.split('\n').length; };
function estTokens(s) { let a = 0, o = 0; for (let i = 0; i < s.length; i++) (s.charCodeAt(i) < 128 ? a++ : o++); return Math.ceil(a / 3.6 + o / 1.6); }

function bundleTree(names, bins) {
  const T = {};
  const add = (n, b) => { const p = n.split('/').filter(Boolean); let o = T; p.forEach((seg, i) => { if (i === p.length - 1) o[seg] = b ? 'b' : 'f'; else { if (typeof o[seg] !== 'object') o[seg] = {}; o = o[seg]; } }); };
  names.forEach(n => add(n, false)); bins.forEach(n => add(n, true));
  const isD = v => typeof v === 'object', lines = [];
  const walk = (o, pre) => {
    const ks = Object.keys(o).sort((a, b) => (isD(o[b]) - isD(o[a])) || (a < b ? -1 : a > b ? 1 : 0));
    ks.forEach((k, i) => {
      const last = i === ks.length - 1;
      lines.push(pre + (last ? '└── ' : '├── ') + k + (isD(o[k]) ? '/' : '') + (o[k] === 'b' ? '  [binary]' : ''));
      if (isD(o[k])) walk(o[k], pre + (last ? '    ' : '│   '));
    });
  };
  walk(T, ''); return lines.join('\n');
}

function bundleInstr(n) {
  return '# Instructions: this is a full project snapshot. Read it, then follow my request.\n' +
    '# When you change files, reply with each CHANGED file in full: a line like  === FILE: path/to/file ===  then its complete content\n' +
    '# (no placeholders, no omitted parts, nothing else between files). Do not repeat unchanged files.' +
    (n > 1 ? '\n# The project is sent in ' + n + ' parts: wait until all parts arrive before answering.' : '');
}

/* يبني الأجزاء: limit = حد التوكنات التقريبي للجزء (0 = كل شيء في جزء واحد). الملف الواحد لا يُقسَّم. */
function bundleBuild(sel, limit, instr) {
  const fl = files.filter(f => !sel || f.name.startsWith(sel + '/')).sort((a, b) => a.name < b.name ? -1 : a.name > b.name ? 1 : 0);
  const bins = [...BIN.keys()].map(n => n.replace(/^\/+/, '')).filter(n => !sel || n.startsWith(sel + '/')).sort();
  const blocks = fl.map(f => { const t = nl(f.content).replace(/\s+$/, ''); return '=== FILE: ' + f.name + ' (' + bLines(t) + ' lines) ===\n' + t + '\n\n'; });
  const root = sel || commonRoot(fl) || 'Project';
  const meta = '# المشروع: ' + root + ' — ' + fl.length + ' ملف' + (bins.length ? ' + ' + bins.length + ' ثنائي' : '') + ' — ' + new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);
  const head1 = N => '# CodePatcher Bundle v1\n' + meta + (N > 1 ? ' — جزء 1/' + N : '') + '\n' + (instr ? bundleInstr(N) + '\n' : '') +
    '\n## خريطة الملفات\n' + bundleTree(fl.map(f => f.name), bins) + '\n\n## محتوى الملفات\n\n';
  const groups = [[]]; let tok = estTokens(head1(2));
  blocks.forEach(b => {
    const bt = estTokens(b), g = groups[groups.length - 1];
    if (limit && g.length && tok + bt > limit) { groups.push([b]); tok = 40 + bt; } else { g.push(b); tok += bt; }
  });
  const N = groups.length;
  return groups.map((g, i) => {
    const head = i === 0 ? head1(N) : '# CodePatcher Bundle v1 (تكملة)\n# جزء ' + (i + 1) + '/' + N + ' — الخريطة في الجزء الأول\n\n';
    const tail = N > 1 ? '# — نهاية الجزء ' + (i + 1) + '/' + N + (i + 1 < N ? ' — سيصل الجزء التالي' : ' — انتهى') + ' —\n' : '';
    return head + g.join('') + tail;
  });
}

  return '# CodePatcher Map\n# ' + (sel || commonRoot() || 'Project') + ' — ' + fl.length + ' ملف\n\n' + bundleTree(fl, bins) + '\n';
}

function bundleSafeName(n) {
  n = String(n || '').trim().replace(/\\+/g, '/').replace(/^(\.\/)+/, '').replace(/^\/+/, '');
  if (!n || n.split('/').some(s => s === '..' || s === '')) return '';
  return n;
}

/* خريطة شجرية (├── └── │ أو مسافات أو قائمة مسارات) ← { files, dirs(فارغة), bins } */
function parseTreeMap(text) {
  const nodes = [], bins = [], stack = [];
  nl(text).split('\n').forEach(raw => {
    if (!raw.trim() || /^\s*#/.test(raw)) return;
    const pre = /^[\s│├└─|`+\-\\¦]*/.exec(raw)[0];
    let name = raw.slice(pre.length).replace(/\s+#.*$/, '').replace(/\s+(?:←|<-+|—|\/\/).*$/, '').trim();
    const isBin = /\s*\[binary\]\s*$/i.test(name); name = name.replace(/\s*\[binary\]\s*$/i, '').trim();
    if (!name || name.length > 120 || /[<>:"|?*\u0000-\u001f]/.test(name)) return;
    const indent = pre.length;
    while (stack.length && stack[stack.length - 1].indent >= indent) stack.pop();
    const parent = stack[stack.length - 1]; if (parent) { parent.isDir = true; parent.kids = true; }
    const isDir = /\/$/.test(name), clean = name.replace(/\/+$/, '');
    if (!clean) return;
    const node = { indent, path: (parent ? parent.path + '/' : '') + clean, isDir, kids: false, bin: isBin };
    stack.push(node); nodes.push(node);
  });
  return {
    files: nodes.filter(n => !n.isDir && !n.bin).map(n => n.path),
    dirs: nodes.filter(n => n.isDir && !n.kids).map(n => n.path),
    bins: nodes.filter(n => n.bin).map(n => n.path),
    looksTree: nodes.length > 0 && nodes.some(n => n.path.includes('/') || /[.]/.test(n.path) || n.isDir)
  };
}

/* يحوّل النص إلى خطة: [{ rel, content, warn, empty }] (rel بلا جذر المشروع) + اسم جذر مقترح */
function bundlePlan(text) {
  const blocks = parseBundle(text), warns = [], bad = []; let raw = [], bins = [], fromMap = false;
  if (blocks && blocks.length) {
    blocks.forEach(p => { const n = bundleSafeName(p.name); if (!n) { bad.push(p.name); return; } if (p.warn) warns.push(n + ': ' + p.warn); raw.push({ path: n, content: p.content }); });
  } else {
    const m = parseTreeMap(text); if (!m.looksTree) return null;
    fromMap = true; bins = m.bins;
    m.files.forEach(f => { const n = bundleSafeName(f); if (n) raw.push({ path: n, content: '', empty: true }); else bad.push(f); });
    m.dirs.forEach(d => { const n = bundleSafeName(d); if (n) raw.push({ path: n + '/.gitkeep', content: '', empty: true }); else bad.push(d); });
  }
  const seen = new Map(); raw.forEach(r => { if (seen.has(r.path)) warns.push(r.path + ': مكرر — اعتُمدت الأخيرة'); seen.set(r.path, r); });
  raw = [...seen.values()];
  if (!raw.length) return null;
  const tops = new Set(raw.map(r => r.path.includes('/') ? r.path.split('/')[0] : null));
  const root = (tops.size === 1 && !tops.has(null)) ? [...tops][0] : '';
  const list = raw.map(r => ({ rel: root ? r.path.slice(root.length + 1) : r.path, content: r.content, empty: !!r.empty })).filter(r => r.rel);
  return { list, root, warns, bad, bins, fromMap };
}

      'try{parent.document.title="x";r.edit="leak"}catch(e){r.edit="blocked"}' +
      'try{var q=parent.indexedDB.open("codepatcher");r.idb="leak"}catch(e){r.idb="blocked"}' +
      'try{localStorage.setItem("a","1");r.ls=localStorage.getItem("a")}catch(e){r.ls="error"}' +
      'try{indexedDB.open("x");r.own="open"}catch(e){r.own="error"}' +

  else {
    T.push({ n: 'العزل: parent.document مرفوض', ok: live.doc === 'blocked' });

    (bad.length ? bad.map(x => `<div class='issue'><b style="color:var(--red,#f87171)">فشل</b><span>${esc(x.n)}</span></div>`).join('') : '<div class="issue"><b>كل الاختبارات ناجحة</b></div>') +

  log(bad.length ? 'err' : 'ok', 'اختبار ذاتي: ' + pass + '/' + T.length);

let clip = null;
function clipResolve(items, fl) {
  fl = fl || files; const out = [], seen = new Set();
  items.forEach(it => {
    if (it.kind === 'file') { const f = fl.find(x => x.id === it.key); if (f && !seen.has(f.id)) { seen.add(f.id); out.push({ id: f.id, rel: f.name.split('/').pop() }); } }
    else { const p = it.key + '/', base = it.key.split('/').pop(); fl.forEach(f => { if (f.name.startsWith(p) && !seen.has(f.id)) { seen.add(f.id); out.push({ id: f.id, rel: base + '/' + f.name.slice(p.length) }); } }); }
  });
  return out;
}
function uniqueCopyName(nn, taken) {
  if (!taken.has(nn)) return nn;
  const i = nn.lastIndexOf('.'), sl = nn.lastIndexOf('/'), ext = i > sl + 1 ? nn.slice(i) : '', stem = ext ? nn.slice(0, i) : nn;
  let k = 1, cand; do { cand = stem + '-copy' + (k > 1 ? k : '') + ext; k++; } while (taken.has(cand));
  return cand;
}
function setClip(mode, items) {
  const c = cur(); if (c) c.content = editor.value;
  const list = clipResolve(items); if (!list.length) return toast('لا ملفات لتحديدها', 'err');
  clip = { mode, list, dirs: items.filter(x => x.kind === 'dir').map(x => x.key) };
  renderTree();
  toast((mode === 'cut' ? 'للنقل: ' : 'للنسخ: ') + list.length + ' ملف — افتح المجلد الهدف ثم اضغط «لصق»', 'ok');
}
function selClip(mode) {
  const items = [...selSet].map(k => ({ kind: k[0] === 'f' ? 'file' : 'dir', key: k.slice(2) }));

}

    lastRename = rec; clip = null; render(); scheduleSave();

  } else {
    const taken = new Set(files.map(f => f.name)), items = [];
    list.forEach(x => {

function dropFixDelta(fixes, base, k) {

'use strict';
/* تحديث الروابط عند إعادة التسمية/النقل */
/* ===== تحديث الروابط عند إعادة التسمية أو النقل ===== */
const LINK_EXT = /\.(html?|css|m?js|jsx|tsx?|svg|xml)$/i;
function normPath(p) {
  const out = [];
  for (const x of p.split('/')) { if (!x || x === '.') continue; if (x === '..') { if (!out.length) return null; out.pop(); } else out.push(x); }
  return out.join('/');
}
function dirOf(p) { const i = p.lastIndexOf('/'); return i < 0 ? '' : p.slice(0, i); }
function relPath(fromDir, to) {
  const a = fromDir ? fromDir.split('/') : [], b = to.split('/'); let i = 0;
  while (i < a.length && i < b.length - 1 && a[i] === b[i]) i++;
  return '../'.repeat(a.length - i) + b.slice(i).join('/');
}
/* لا يُعدَّل إلا نص بين علامتي اقتباس أو داخل url() يشير فعلاً إلى ملف موجود في المشروع */
function planLinkUpdates(moves) {
  const names = new Set(files.map(f => f.name)), mv = p => moves.has(p) ? moves.get(p) : p;
  const list = []; let total = 0;
  const re = /(["'])([^"'\s<>`]{1,300})\1|url\(\s*([^)"'\s]+)\s*\)/g;
  files.forEach(g => {
    if (!LINK_EXT.test(g.name)) return;
    const gOld = g.name, gNew = mv(gOld), src = g.content; let n = 0;
    const after = src.replace(re, (m, q, s1, s2) => {
      const raw = s1 != null ? s1 : s2;
      if (!raw || /^([a-z][a-z0-9+.-]*:|\/\/|#)/i.test(raw)) return m;
      const mm = /^([^?#]*)([?#].*)?$/.exec(raw), pp = mm[1], tail = mm[2] || '';
      if (!pp) return m;
      const abs = pp[0] === '/';
      const target = normPath(abs ? pp : (dirOf(gOld) ? dirOf(gOld) + '/' : '') + pp);
      if (target == null || !names.has(target)) return m;
      const t2 = mv(target);
      if (t2 === target && dirOf(gNew) === dirOf(gOld)) return m;
      let np = abs ? '/' + t2 : relPath(dirOf(gNew), t2);
      if (!abs && pp.startsWith('./') && !np.startsWith('.')) np = './' + np;
      if (np === pp) return m;
      n++;
      return q !== undefined ? q + np + tail + q : 'url(' + np + tail + ')';
    });
    if (n) { list.push({ f: g, before: src, after, n }); total += n; }
  });
  return { list, total };
}
function applyLinkEdits(list) {
  return list.map(e => {
    const f = e.f;
    if (f.id === activeId) setAll(e.after);
    else { pushHist(f, diffRange(f.content, e.after), true); f.content = e.after; f.dirtySave = true; }
    return { f, before: e.before, after: e.after };
  });
}
function undoRename() {

  if (r.ren.some(x => x.f.name !== x.to || rest.has(x.from))) return toast('تعذر التراجع: تغيّرت الأسماء', 'err');
  r.edits.forEach(e => {
    const f = e.f; if (!files.includes(f)) return;
    if (f.id === activeId) { if (editor.value === e.after) setAll(e.before); }
    else if (f.content === e.after) { pushHist(f, diffRange(f.content, e.before), true); f.content = e.before; f.dirtySave = true; }

{

  const ap = applyPatch;
  applyPatch = function () {
    const txt = $('patchInput').value; phEv = null; const r = ap.apply(this, arguments); const ev = phEv;
    if (ev && txt.trim() && txt.length < 400000) {
      const done = !ev.blocked && ev.changed.length && ev.changed.every(k => { const f = files.find(x => x.name === k); return f && f.content === ev.work[k]; });
